evals.prompt: سلام. اهداف من برای آکادمی اینترنتی آموزش کسب‌وکارم اینه: تا ۲ سال دیگه برسیم به درآمد ماهی ۵۰۰ میلیون تومن و ۱۰ هزار دانشجو. الان پیج اینستاگراممون ۸ هزار فالوئر داره و ماهی حدود ۴۰ میلیون تومن فروش داریم با ۲ تا دوره. نظرت چیه؟ یه برنامه ۵ ساله هم بهم بده.
evals.expected_output: Candid CEO-style feasibility analysis with numbers (funnel math, gap analysis), a structured 5-year plan with yearly milestones and KPIs, goals recorded in academy/goals.md and plan in academy/strategy/five-year-plan.md, all in Persian.
assertions: Gives a candid, numbers-based feasibility verdict on the 500M-toman/month in 2 years goal (funnel or gap math, not just agreement)
Five-year plan includes year-by-year milestones with numeric targets for revenue and students
Records the goals in an academy/goals.md state file with a CEO opinion per goal
Creates academy/strategy/five-year-plan.md including risks and explicit assumptions
Plan includes quarterly OKRs or quarterly breakdown for year 1

evals.prompt: برای ماه آینده تقویم محتوای اینستاگرام آکادمی رو بچین (پیج ما درباره آموزش ترید و سرمایه‌گذاریه) و با بودجه ۵۰ میلیون تومن بگو چه تبلیغاتی بذاریم.
evals.expected_output: A monthly Instagram content calendar with dated posts, formats, and at least some fully-drafted captions; an ad plan that allocates the 50M toman budget across channels with tracking metrics (CPL/CAC) and a stop-loss rule; ads marked as requiring approval before spending; files saved under academy/, all in Persian.
assertions: Monthly Instagram calendar covers ~4 weeks with dated entries and post formats (reels/post/story)
At least two posts have fully drafted captions with a hook, hashtags, and a CTA
Ad plan allocates the 50M toman budget numerically across specific channels
Ad plan defines tracking (CPL/CAC/ROAS targets, discount codes or UTM) and a stop-loss rule
Ad spending is marked as pending owner approval rather than assumed authorized
Creates academy/ state files (instagram/calendar.md and ads/campaigns.md)
